content.text: That broke the workspace build — the transaction reference outlived its table. I reverted the change and will retry with the commit before the reference drops.
Lesson learned: never hold the buffer lock across an await point, it deadlocks under concurrent requests. I will keep the lock scope to the byte copy only.
